inputs.name: VISCOSITY_OK
inputs.description: Raw signal indicating that viscosity is within the permitted range.

inputs.name: PASTE_E_STOP_NC
inputs.description: Normally closed emergency-stop circuit; TRUE permits operation and FALSE means emergency stop.

inputs.name: DebounceTime
inputs.description: Required continuous valid duration for the viscosity signal; must be positive.

inputs.name: CycleTime
inputs.description: Actual elapsed interval represented by this invocation; must be positive.

outputs.name: PUMP_MAINT_DUE
outputs.description: Maintenance indication when accumulated runtime reaches 500 hours.

outputs.name: PUMP_RUNTIME_ACC
outputs.description: Accumulated enabled runtime, using a long-duration time type.
